newsitem.title: UK: Emery wins Dade International contract.
newsitem.headline: Emery wins Dade International contract.

text.p: Emery Worldwide said on Wednesday it has won a six-year logistics management contract from Dade International, to manage and operate a European distribution centre in Anderlecht, Belgium.

Co-ordinated by Dade's European headquarters in Duedingen, Switzerland, Emery will manage a comprehensive logistics programme, which includes the storage and central European distribution of the company's wide-ranging healthcare product lines.
The contract is being managed by Emery global logistics in conjunction with Dade's European warehouse and distribution manager, Werner Moser.

Randy Clark, managing director of Emery's global logistics units said: "Through our experience in operating single and multi-user warehouses and the expertise of Emery's pharmaceutical and healthcare global industry group, we have been able to design a program that fulfils Dade's unique needs.
"We are looking forward to working in partnership with Dade to continuously improve its supply-chain management strategy." - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
